rules.unit: AMA PRA Category 1 Credits or equivalent
rules.accepted_credit_types: AMA PRA Category 1 Credits or Board-recognized equivalents (AOA Category 1-A, AAFP prescribed hours, ACOG cognates, grand rounds, ABMS certification/MOC, Board-designated programs)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt in the calendar year of initial licensure; the professional boundaries course must be done within 12 months of licensure.
rules.audit_note: Random audit of physicians and PAs every year; do not send certificates unless asked. Keep CME records 3 years after the year earned.

topics.who: All licensed PAs: Board-provided course "Navigating Professional Boundaries in Medicine" (due Dec 31, 2025; new licensees within 12 months)
PAs holding a QACSC (controlled substance certificate): 4 AMA PRA Category 1 credits every 2 years via a Board-approved course; initial QACSC needs 12 credits incl. the Board 8-hour course

rules.notes: License renewed every year by Dec 31; CME is 50 credits per 2 years. PAs in a supervisory practice must also take Board-prescribed collaborative/supervisory CME (60-month look-back). Board page cites no PA rule number.
